label: Ossau-Iraty
note: Farm versions raw milk only. Pressed, uncooked: heating stays below 44 °C.

about.text: Ossau-Iraty is a Basque and Béarn cheese made from sheep milk, with AOC status since 1980. It is an uncooked, pressed cheese from the Basco-Béarnaise, Manech red-face and Manech black-face breeds.

steps.note: With under 3 cm³ of rennet per 10 L.
In perforated moulds, pressed and turned, and demoulded when the pH is below 5.5.

processing.text: Non-GMO lactic ferments, species not named. The rind is brushed with a salt, water and surface-ferment solution, washed with morge. Ripening is at least 80 d (2-3 kg) or 120 d (4-7 kg).
